values.DataCenterNotes: Tallgrass's Cheyenne Power Hub in Laramie County, Wyoming, will burn gas from the Rockies Express Pipeline to power a data center campus known as Project Jade.

verifications.note: Power Engineering, May 2026: the hub's first-phase turbines are fueled by gas from Tallgrass' Rockies Express Pipeline; the hub serves the Project Jade data center.

records.researcher_notes: A Power Engineering article from May 2026 says the first phase of Tallgrass's Cheyenne Power Hub will run on gas from the Rockies Express Pipeline. The hub serves a data center campus called Project Jade. No new lateral was reported, so this is demand on the existing line. One source was found; no second was searched because the session's web search budget ran out.

values.DataCenterNotes: DT Midstream added a new 250 million cubic feet per day interconnect on the NEXUS mainline to supply a gas plant that powers a new data center in Ohio. The data center is not named.

verifications.note: DT Midstream first quarter 2026 earnings call, April 30, 2026: new NEXUS interconnect, 250 MMcf/d, supplies a behind-the-meter gas plant powering a new data center in Ohio.

records.researcher_notes: On its earnings call of April 30, 2026, DT Midstream said it signed a new interconnect on NEXUS for 250 million cubic feet per day. It supplies the company's own gas plant that powers a new data center in Ohio. The company said it chose not to build a lateral, so the load sits on the NEXUS mainline. The data center is not named, so the tag is medium. The call transcript is from The Motley Fool. A second interconnect for another Ohio data center was reported later in 2026 but was not read here.

ledger.note: Rockies Express supplies the Cheyenne Power Hub, which powers the Project Jade data center (Power Engineering, May 2026).
DT Midstream's April 2026 earnings call: a new NEXUS interconnect feeds a gas plant powering an Ohio data center.

A Pennsylvania environmental agency letter from August 2025 says Kinder Morgan's MARC-1 line and Williams Transco are both available to supply the Wyalusing gas plant, which powers a data center. It does not say which line will supply it. Left blank until a source names the supplier.
